Title: Dawn opp and Illusions of the Kindred

Messages.Author: Walter Denny
Messages.Body:
This is probably a stupid question. However here it goes.

If a vamp plays Dawn opp and then during the combat plays Illusions of the
Kindred. Is the damage during the combat with the "Illusionary Kindred"
still aggravated.

Messages.Author: Halcyan 2
Messages.Body:


Probably not. Dawn opp refers to the "resulting combat." What Illusions of the
Kindred does is start an entirely new combat. So just like how other cards that
might affect the first combat (Trap, etc.), it isn't carried over because it's
a different combat.

Halcyan 2
